titleEn: The Glory of Kings — Solomon Sends His Son to Reign, and the Son Is Crowned (ch. 38–39)
part: ch. 38–39 — Solomon Sends His Son to Reign, and the Son Is Crowned
about: Solomon calls his counsellors and proposes that the leading men of Israel send their firstborn sons with his own son to rule Ethiopia, so that his seed will hold three thrones: Israel, Rome and Ethiopia. He cites David's psalms, and the courtiers agree. In chapter 39 the son is anointed in the Holy of Holies, takes the name David, and is blessed by his father. Several words, including the instruments, the acclamation and a few verbs, are uncertain and marked (?).

sentences.t: ፴፰ ፡ ኀበ ፡ መከረ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ይፈኑ ፡ ወልዶ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ደቂቆሙ ።
sentences.l: 38. Where took-counsel king that-they-send his-son with sons-of-them.
sentences.i: Chapter 38: How the king took counsel to send his son out with their sons.
sentences.n: Chapter heading. ኀበ here 'where' in `l`, 'how' in `i`, the same loose use as in ch. 37 (?). መከረ 'he took counsel' (perfect, 3rd masc.); ይፈኑ is a subjunctive 'that they send' (root ፈነወ 'send'), plural because the sending covers the son and the others. ወልዶ = ወልድ 'son' + -ሁ 'his' contracted; ደቂቆሙ = ደቂቅ 'sons' (plural of ወልድ) + -ሆሙ 'their'. ምስለ 'with'. ፴፰ is the numeral 38 (30 + 8).

sentences.t: ወእምዝ ፡ ገብአ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ቤቱ ፡ ሰሎሞን ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ወአስተጋብኦሙ ፡ ለመማክርቲሁ ፡ ወለመገብቱ ፡ ወለመላህቅተ ፡ ቤተ ፡ መንግሥቱ ፡ ወይቤሎሙ ፡ ስእንኩ ፡ ኦሆ ፡ አብሎቶ ፡ ለዝንቱ ፡ ወልድ ፤
sentences.l: And-then entered into house-his Solomon king, and-gathered-them to-counsellors-his and-to-stewards-his (?) and-to-elders-of house-of kingdom-his, and-said-to-them: I-was-unable, yes, to-restrain-him (?) this son;
sentences.i: Then King Solomon went back into his house and gathered his counsellors, his stewards (?) and the elders of his royal household, and said to them: 'I have been unable, yes, to hold this son back (?);
sentences.n: ወእምዝ 'and then' (ወ- 'and' + እምዝ 'after this'). ገብአ 'he entered, returned'. ወአስተጋብኦሙ 'and he gathered them': ወ- + አስተጋብአ (causative, root ጋብአ) + -ሆሙ 'them'. ለመማክርቲሁ 'to his counsellors': ለ- marks the object here (not 'to'), then መማክርት (plural of መካሪ 'counsellor') + -ሁ. ወለመገብቱ: መገብት is uncertain to me (?), perhaps 'stewards, those in charge of provisions'. ለመላህቅተ ቤተ መንግሥቱ 'the elders of the house of his kingdom': መላህቅት 'elders' in the construct before ቤተ 'house-of' before መንግሥቱ 'kingdom-his'. ስእንኩ 'I was unable' (ስእነ, 1st sing. perfect); ኦሆ 'yes, indeed' (?). አብሎቶ is unclear (?): I read it as a verbal noun, 'restraining him', hence 'to hold him back', with ለዝንቱ ወልድ 'this son' as its object. This follows ch. 37, where the son insists on leaving for his mother's country.

sentences.t: ወይእዜኒ ፡ ስምዑኒ ፡ ዘእነግረክሙ ፡ ሀቡ ፡ ናንግሦ ፡ ለብሔረ ፡ ኢትዮጵያ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ደቂቅክሙ ፡ እለ ፡ ትነብሩ ፡ በየማንየ ፡ ወበፀጋምየ ፡ ከማሁ ፡ ይንበሩ ፡ ደቂቅክሙ ፡ መላህቅት ፡ በየማኑ ፡ ወበፀጋሙ ፤
sentences.l: And-now hear-me that-which I-tell-you: come, let-us-make-king-him over-land-of Ethiopia with sons-your who dwell at right-my and-at left-my; likewise let-dwell sons-your the-elders at right-his and-at left-his;
sentences.i: 'And now hear me, as I tell you: come, let us make him king over the land of Ethiopia, together with your sons who sit at my right hand and my left. In the same way let your elder sons sit at his right hand and his left;
sentences.n: ወይእዜኒ 'and now' (ወይእዜ + the emphatic particle -ኒ). ስምዑኒ 'hear me' (imperative plural + -ኒ 'me'). ዘእነግረክሙ 'that which I tell you' (ዘ- 'that which' + እነግር 'I tell' + -ክሙ 'you pl.'). ሀቡ is the plural imperative of ሀበ 'give', used as an exhortation, 'come now' (?); it is followed by ናንግሦ 'let us make him king' (ኖ-form cohortative of አንገሠ, the causative of ነግሠ 'reign'). ለብሔረ ኢትዮጵያ: ለ- here introduces the land over which he is to rule; ብሔረ is the construct 'land-of'. እለ ትነብሩ is 'who sit' with a 2nd-plural verb after a 3rd-plural antecedent, a slip or a looseness in the printed text (?). በየማንየ 'at my right hand' (በ- 'at, in' + የማን 'right' + -የ 'my'), ወበፀጋምየ 'and at my left'; sitting at the right and left is the place of counsellors and heirs. ከማሁ 'likewise'. ይንበሩ is jussive.

sentences.t: ወኵልክሙ ፡ መማክርት ፡ ወመኳንንት ፡ ሀቡ ፡ ነሀብ ፡ ደቂቅክሙ ፡ በኵረ ፡ ወይከውን ፡ ለነ ፡ ክልኤ ፡ መንግሥት ፡ ወአንሰ ፡ ምስሌክሙ ፡ በዝየ ፡ እትለአክ ፡ ወደቂቅነሂ ፡ ይነግሡ ፡ በሂየ ፤
sentences.l: and-all-you counsellors and-nobles, come, let-us-give your-sons, firstborn, and-will-be to-us two kingdoms; and-I with-you here shall-be-sent (?), and-sons-our-also shall-reign there;
sentences.i: and all of you, counsellors and nobles, come, let us give your firstborn sons, and we will have two kingdoms. I shall stay (?) here with you, and our sons will reign there;
sentences.n: ወኵልክሙ 'and all of you' (ኵሉ 'all' + -ክሙ). መኳንንት 'nobles, governors'. ነሀብ is the cohortative 'let us give', parallel to ሀቡ. በኵረ 'firstborn' (accusative; the plural sense 'firstborn ones' is taken from context). ክልኤ መንግሥት 'two kingdoms'. ወአንሰ 'and as for me' (-ሰ contrastive). እትለአክ is difficult (?): from ተለአከ, which gives 'I shall be sent' or 'I shall serve'; in context 'I shall stay' (?) is only a guess. ወደቂቅነሂ 'and our sons also' (-ሂ 'also'). በሂየ is a variant spelling of በህየ 'there', kept as printed.

sentences.t: ወሣልሰኒ ፡ እሴፈዎ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፡ ከመ ፡ የሀበኒ ፡ ዘርአ ፡ ወይከውን ፡ ሊተ ፡ ሣልሰ ፡ ንጉሠ ።
sentences.l: And-third I-hope in-God that he-give-me seed and-will-be to-me a-third king.
sentences.i: And thirdly, I hope in God that he will give me offspring, and that I will have a third king.
sentences.n: ወሣልሰኒ 'and thirdly' (ሣልስ 'third' + -ኒ). እሴፈዎ 'I hope in him' (ሴፈወ 'hope, expect', with -ኦ 'him'; ለእግዚኣብሔር 'in/of God' repeats the object). ከመ የሀበኒ 'that he give me' (ከመ + subjunctive ይሁብ + -ኒ). ዘርአ 'seed, offspring'. ሊተ 'to me' is the independent dative form. ሣልሰ ንጉሠ: ንጉሠ is the accusative 'a king', the accusative in -ä marking the predicate. This is Solomon's hope for a further heir from the Roman alliance described next.

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ የኀሥሥ ፡ በልጣሶር ፡ ንጉሠ ፡ ሮሜ ፡ ከመ ፡ አሀቦ ፡ ወልድየ ፡ ለወለቱ ፡ ወያንግሦ ፡ ሊተ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ወለቱ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ሀገረሮሜ ፤
sentences.l: For seeks Baltasor king-of Rome that I-give-him my-son to-his-daughter and-he-make-king-him for-me with his-daughter over all city-of-Rome;
sentences.i: For Baltasor, the king of Rome, seeks that I give my son to his daughter, and that he install him as king for me, with his daughter, over all the city of Rome;
sentences.n: እስመ 'for, because'. የኀሥሥ 'he seeks' (ኀሠሠ). በልጣሶር is the king's name as printed (Belshazzar/Baltasar? I give it in Geʿez form). ንጉሠ ሮሜ 'king of Rome': ንጉሥ in the construct, with the case-vowel ä. ከመ አሀቦ 'that I give him' (1st-sing. subjunctive of ሀበ); ወልድየ 'my son' (ወልድ + -የ). ለወለቱ 'to his daughter' (ለ- + ወለት 'daughter' + -ሁ). ወያንግሦ 'and (that) he make him king' (3rd masc. subject, Baltasor). ሊተ 'for me'. ሀገረሮሜ is printed as one word, ሀገረ ሮሜ 'city-of Rome'. The 'my son' here is another son of Solomon, distinct from the one who is leaving.

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ አልቦውሉደ ፡ ዘርአ ፡ ዘእንበሌሃ ፡ ወመሐለ ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢያንግሥ ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡ እምዘርአ ፡ ዳዊት ፡ አቡየ ፤
sentences.l: for none begotten seed except her, and-he-swore that not-he-enthrone except from seed-of David my-father;
sentences.i: for he has no child except her, and he has sworn that he will make no one king except one from the seed of David my father;
sentences.n: አልቦውሉደ is printed as one word, አልቦ ውሉደ 'there is no offspring'. ዘርአ ዘእንበሌሃ 'seed apart from her' (ዘእንበለ 'without, except' + -ሃ 'her'). ወመሐለ 'and he swore'. ከመ ኢያንግሥ 'that he not make king' (negative subjunctive). ዘእንበለ እምዘርአ ዳዊት 'except from the seed of David'; እም- 'from' is the proclitic. Solomon here describes his own line as the only acceptable royal line, even to a foreign king; the theme of David's seed as the covenanted dynasty (2 Samuel 7:12-16) runs through the passage.

sentences.t: ወለእመ ፡ አንገሥነ ፡ ህየኒ ፡ ንከውን ፡ ሠለስተ ፡ ንጉሠ ፤
sentences.l: and-if he-enthrone us there-too, we-shall-be three kings;
sentences.i: and if he makes us kings there too (?), we shall be three kings;
sentences.n: ወለእመ 'and if'. አንገሥነ is ambiguous (?): 'he enthroned us' or 'we enthroned (him)'; I take 'he made us kings there as well', since the point is the count of kingdoms. ህየኒ 'there also'. ንከውን 'we shall be' (1st plural). ሠለስተ ንጉሠ 'three kings' (ሠለስት 'three' in the construct before ንጉሥ).

sentences.t: ወኢዮርብዓምኒ ፡ ይነግሥ ፡ ዝየ ፡ ለእስራኤል ፡ እስመ ፡ ከመዝ ፡ ትንቢቱ ፡ ለዳዊት ፡ አቡየ ፡ ይከውን ፡ ዘርኡ ፡ ለሰሎሞን ፡ ፫ ፡ አርእስተ ፡ መንግሥት ፡ በዲበ ፡ ምድር ።
sentences.l: And-Jeroboam-also shall-reign here over Israel, for thus (is) prophecy-his to-David my-father: will-be his-seed, of-Solomon, 3 heads-of kingdom upon earth.
sentences.i: And Jeroboam also shall reign here over Israel, for so is the prophecy to David my father: Solomon's seed will be three heads of kingship upon the earth.
sentences.n: ወኢዮርብዓምኒ: Jeroboam (ኢዮርብዓም) is kept as printed. In the Bible Jeroboam was a northern rival, and Solomon's heir was Rehoboam (ሮብዓም); the text uses the name for the heir who stays in Israel, as a name of the line (?). I follow the printed text. ይነግሥ 'he shall reign'. ዝየ 'here'. ትንቢቱ ለዳዊት 'his prophecy to David' (ትንቢት 'prophecy'). ፫ is the numeral 3, 'spoken' ሠለስቱ; here it stands before አርእስተ 'heads-of' (construct of ርእስ 'head'), so 'three heads of kingship', that is three throne-lines: Israel, Rome, Ethiopia. The prophecy is not a verse I can identify in David's writings; it is the text's own claim of a promise to David.

sentences.t: ወንፌኑ ፡ ሎሙ ፡ ካህናተ ፡ ወንሥራዕ ፡ ሎሙ ፡ ሕገጋተ ፡ ወያምልኩ ፡ ወይግነዩ ፡ ለአምላከ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ውስተ ፡ አርእስተ ፡ መንግሥት ፡ ወይሴባሕ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ በዘመደ ፡ ሕዝቡ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ወይትሌዐል ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ምድር ።
sentences.l: And-let-us-send to-them priests, and-let-us-establish for-them laws, and-they-shall-worship and-shall-praise God-of Israel in the heads-of kingdom, and-shall-be-praised God among kindred-of his-people Israel and-shall-be-exalted in all earth.
sentences.i: 'Let us send priests to them, and let us establish laws for them, so that they worship and sing to the God of Israel in these three royal seats, and that God may be praised among the kindred of his people Israel and be exalted over all the earth.
sentences.n: ወንፌኑ 'and let us send' (cohortative). ሎሙ 'to them'. ካህናተ 'priests' (accusative plural). ወንሥራዕ ሎሙ ሕገጋተ 'and let us establish laws for them' (ሠርዐ 'establish, ordain'; ሕግ plural ሕገጋት). ወያምልኩ ወይግነዩ 'and they will worship and bow/serve' (ግንየ 'bow down, serve'; the exact nuance is (?)), subjunctive continuing the cohortative. ለአምላከ እስራኤል 'to the God of Israel' (አምላከ is the construct 'God-of'). ወይሴባሕ 'and he will be praised': the ይ-ተ pattern of ሰብሐ (passive), subject እግዚኣብሔር. በዘመደ ሕዝቡ 'among the kinsfolk of his people' (ዘመድ 'kin'). ወይትሌዐል 'and he will be exalted' (ተለዐለ). The hope that God be praised among all the earth echoes Psalm 57:5 and 108:5, 'be exalted over the heavens, over all the earth' (?).

sentences.t: በከመ ፡ ጸሐፈ ፡ አቡየ ፡ ውስተ ፡ መጽሐፉ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ይብል ፡ በልዎሙ ፡ ለአሕዛብ ፡ ከመ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ነግሠ ፤
sentences.l: As wrote my-father in his-book saying: say to-the-nations that God has-reigned;
sentences.i: As my father wrote in his book, saying: "Tell the nations that the Lord reigns";
sentences.n: በከመ 'as, just as'. ጸሐፈ 'he wrote'; አቡየ 'my father' (አብ + -የ) is David, and መጽሐፉ 'his book' is the Psalter. እንዘ ይብል 'saying' (እንዘ + imperfect = a circumstantial 'while he says'). በልዎሙ ለአሕዛብ 'say to them, to the nations': the plural imperative of ይቤ takes the pronoun -ሙ and then ለአሕዛብ 'to the nations'. ነግሠ 'has reigned'. This quotes Psalm 96:10 (LXX 95:10), 'Say among the nations: the Lord reigns.' The Geʿez Psalter's wording may differ slightly; the verse is identified from sense (?).

sentences.t: ወካዕበ ፡ ይቤ ፡ ወንግርዎሙ ፡ ለአሕዛብ ፡ ምግባሮ ፡ ሰብሕዎ ፡ ወዘምሩ ፡ ሎቱ ፤
sentences.l: and-again he-said: and-tell to-the-nations his-deeds, praise-him and-sing to-him;
sentences.i: and again he said: "Make his deeds known to the nations; praise him and sing to him";
sentences.n: ወካዕበ ይቤ 'and again he said', the formula that links the quotations. ወንግርዎሙ 'and tell them' (plural imperative of ነገረ + -ሆሙ). ምግባሮ 'his deeds' (ምግባር 'deed' + -ኦ). ሰብሕዎ 'praise him' (imperative plural of ሰብሐ). ወዘምሩ ሎቱ 'and sing to him' (ዘመረ 'sing psalms'). Compare Psalm 105:1-2 and 96:3 ('declare his glory among the nations'), 'sing to him, sing praises'. It is a loose citation of the psalms, not a word-for-word match (?).

sentences.t: ወካዕበ ፡ ይቤ ፡ ሰብሕዎ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፡ ስብሐተ ፡ ሐዲሰ ፤
sentences.l: and-again said: praise to-God a-new praise;
sentences.i: and again he said: "Sing to the Lord a new song";
sentences.n: ስብሐተ ሐዲሰ 'a new praise': ስብሐት 'praise, hymn, song' in the accusative, ሐዲስ 'new', also accusative. 'Sing a new song to the Lord' appears in Psalm 96:1, 98:1 and 149:1; the next unit continues with Psalm 149. In the Psalter ሰብሕዎ ለእግዚኣብሔር takes the sense 'sing to the Lord'; in `i` I use the familiar 'song' for ስብሐት.

sentences.t: ስብሐቲሁ ፡ በማኅበረ ፡ ጻድቃኑ ፡ ይትፌሣሕ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ በፈጣሪሁ ፡ ለነ ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ክብረመንግሥት ፡ ወንሴብሕ ፡ ለፈጣሪነ ፡ ወይርአዩ ፡ ኪያነ ፡ አሕዛብ ፡ እለ ፡ ያመልኩ ፡ ጣዖተ ፡ ወይፍርሁነ ፡ ወያንግሡነ ፡ ወይሴብሕዎ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወይፍርህዎ ።
sentences.l: His-praises in assembly-of his-righteous. Let-rejoice Israel in his-maker; for-us is glory-of-kingdom, and-let-us-praise our-maker, and-will-see us nations who worship idols, and-fear us and-make-us-king and-praise God and-fear him.
sentences.i: "His praise is in the assembly of his righteous ones; let Israel rejoice in its Maker." The glory of kingship is ours, and let us praise our Maker, and the nations who worship idols will see us, and fear us, and make us kings, and praise God and fear him.
sentences.n: The first clause echoes Psalm 149:1-2: 'his praise in the assembly of the faithful... let Israel rejoice in his Maker.' ስብሐቲሁ 'his praises' (ስብሐት + -ሁ). በማኅበረ ጻድቃኑ 'in the assembly of his righteous ones' (በ- 'in', ማኅበረ construct, ጻድቃን 'righteous' + -ሁ). ይትፌሣሕ 'let him rejoice' (ተፈሥሐ). በፈጣሪሁ 'in his Maker' (ፈጣሪ 'creator'). From ለነ ይእቲ 'ours is it' the text is Solomon's own comment: ክብረመንግሥት is printed as one word, ክብረ መንግሥት 'glory of kingship' (the book's title phrase ክብረ ነገሥት 'glory of kings' is related). ኪያነ 'us' (accusative independent pronoun). እለ ያመልኩ ጣዖተ 'who worship idols' (ጣዖት, accusative plural form ጣዖተ). The two last verbs, ይፍርሁነ and ይፍርህዎ, are 'fear us' and 'fear him'; ያንግሡነ 'make us kings'. The idea that nations will acknowledge Israel is the text's own application of the psalms.

sentences.t: ወይእዜኒ ፡ ሀቡ ፡ ናንግሦ ፡ ወንፈንዎ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ደቂቅክሙ ፡ እለ ፡ ብክሙ ፡ ምርካበ ፡ ወሢመተ ፤
sentences.l: And-now come, let-us-make-king-him and-let-us-send-him with your-sons who have-to-you rank and-office;
sentences.i: And now come, let us make him king and send him with your sons, those who hold rank and office among you;
sentences.n: ወይእዜኒ 'and now'. ወንፈንዎ 'and let us send him' (cohortative + -ኦ). እለ ብክሙ 'who are with you, who you have' (ብ- 'there is, has' + -ክሙ 'you'). ምርካብ is uncertain (?), taken as 'rank, standing, station' (from ረከበ 'find, obtain'); ሢመት 'office, appointment'. Both are accusatives after the 'have' construction.

sentences.t: በከመ ፡ ሢመትክሙ ፡ ወምርካብክሙ ፡ በዝየ ፡ ይኩን ፡ ከማሁ ፡ ለደቂቅክሙ ፡ በህየ ፤
sentences.l: as your-office and-your-rank here be, so for-your-sons there;
sentences.i: as your office and your rank are here, so let them be for your sons there;
sentences.n: በከመ 'as' ... ከማሁ 'so, likewise' is a correlative pair. ሢመትክሙ ወምርካብክሙ 'your office and your rank' (see the previous unit for the doubtful ምርካብ). ይኩን jussive 'let it be'. በዝየ 'here', በህየ 'there'. The point is a transfer of the Israelite court, rank for rank, to Ethiopia.

sentences.t: ወይርአዩ ፡ ሕገ ፡ መንግሥት ፡ ወንረስዮሙ ፡ በከመ ፡ ሕግነ ፡ ወነአዝዞሙ ፡ ሕገ ፡ ወትእዛዛተ ፡ ወንፈንዎሙ ፡ ይንገሡ ፡ በህየ ፨
sentences.l: and-they-shall-see law-of kingdom, and-let-us-make-them according-to our-law, and-let-us-command-them law and commandments, and-let-us-send-them that-they-reign there.
sentences.i: They will learn (lit. 'see') the law of kingship; let us shape them by our law, give them statute and commandments, and send them to reign there.
sentences.n: ወይርአዩ 'and they will see', here 'learn'. ሕገ መንግሥት 'law of kingship' (ሕገ construct). ወንረስዮሙ 'and let us make them, set them' (ረሰየ 'make, set, turn into'); the sense 'bring them into conformity with our law' follows በከመ ሕግነ 'according to our law' (?). ወነአዝዞሙ 'let us command them' (አዘዘ). ወትእዛዛተ 'commandments' (ትእዛዝ). ይንገሡ 'that they reign'. The unit ends at ፨, a larger stop, ending the king's speech.

sentences.t: ወአውሥኡ ፡ ወይቤሉ ፡ ካህናት ፡ ወመኳንንት ፡ ወመማክርት ፡ ለንጉሥ ፡ አንተ ፡ ትፌንዎ ፡ ለበኵርከ ፡ ወንሕነ ፡ ንፌኑ ፡ ደቂቅነ ፡ እለ ፡ ብነ ፡ በከመ ፡ ፈቀድከ ፤
sentences.l: And-answered and-said priests and-nobles and-counsellors to-the-king: You send-him your-firstborn, and-we send our-sons who we-have, as you-wished;
sentences.i: The priests, nobles and counsellors answered the king and said: 'You send your firstborn, and we shall send the sons we have, as you wish;
sentences.n: ወአውሥኡ ወይቤሉ 'and they answered and said' (አውሥአ 'answer'). ካህናት ወመኳንንት ወመማክርት 'priests and nobles and counsellors', the three groups of the court. አንተ ትፌንዎ ለበኵርከ 'you shall send your firstborn' (ትፌንዎ is the 2nd-sing. imperfect; ለ- marks the object, በኵር 'firstborn' + -ከ). ንፌኑ 'we shall send'. እለ ብነ 'those we have' (ብ- + -ነ 'us'). ፈቀድከ 'you wished' (perfect).

sentences.t: መኑ ፡ የአቢ ፡ ትእዛዞ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወለንጉሥ ፤
sentences.l: who would-refuse the-command-his of-God and-of-king?
sentences.i: who would refuse the command of God and of the king?
sentences.n: መኑ 'who?'. የአቢ 'he refuses' (አበየ 'refuse'); the rhetorical question means 'no one'. ትእዛዞ 'his command' (ትእዛዝ + -ኦ); ለእግዚኣብሔር ወለንጉሥ 'of God and of the king', the repeated ለ- being a possessive 'belonging to'.

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ አግብርቲከ ፡ እሙንቱ ፡ ለከ ፡ ወለዘርእከ ፡ በከመ ፡ ነበብከ ፤
sentences.l: for servants-your are-they to-you and-to-your-seed, as you-have-spoken;
sentences.i: for they are your servants, yours and your descendants', as you have said;
sentences.n: አግብርቲከ 'your servants' (አግብርት, plural of ገብር, + -ከ). እሙንቱ 'they' (independent pronoun). ለከ ወለዘርእከ 'to you and to your seed' (ዘርእ + -ከ; ዘርእከ spelled with the contracted suffix). ነበብከ 'you have spoken' (ነበበ 'speak').

sentences.t: ለእመ ፡ ፈቀድከ ፡ እምሤጥኮሙ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይኩኑ ፡ አግብርተ ፡ ምስለ ፡ እማቲሆሙ ፤
sentences.l: if you-wish, rather-than selling-them (?), that-they-be slaves with their-maidservants (?);
sentences.i: if you wish, they may even be sold (?), to be slaves together with their maidservants (?);
sentences.n: This unit is uncertain. ለእመ ፈቀድከ 'if you wish'. እምሤጥኮሙ is taken as እም- + ሤጥኮሙ, a form from ሠየጠ 'sell', 'your selling them' (?), the እም- maybe 'rather than' or 'by'. I give a loose 'may even be sold' (?). ከመ ይኩኑ አግብርተ 'that they be slaves'. እማቲሆሙ 'their maidservants' (እምት 'maidservant', plural እማት, + -ሆሙ). The point is plain: the courtiers declare their total obedience even to the extreme of being enslaved.

sentences.t: ወአልቦ ፡ ዘንትዐደው ፡ እምትእዛዝከ ፡ ወእምትእዛዘ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ አምላክከ ።
sentences.l: and-there-is-not (one) whom we-transgress-from your-command and-from command-of God your-God.
sentences.i: and there is nothing by which we would transgress your command, or the command of the Lord your God.
sentences.n: ወአልቦ 'and there is not'. ዘንትዐደው 'that we transgress' (ዘ- + ንትዐደው, 1st plural of ተዐደወ 'transgress, pass over'). እምትእዛዝከ 'from your command' (እም- 'from' + ትእዛዝ + -ከ). ትእዛዘ is the construct 'command-of' before እግዚኣብሔር; አምላክከ 'your God'. The whole speech is built on the pairing 'God and king'.

sentences.t: ወእምዝ ፡ አስተዳለዉ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይግበሩ ፡ ሎሙ ፡ ዘበሕግ ፡ ወይፈንውዎሙ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ብሔረ ፡ ኢትዮጵያ ፡ ወይንገሡ ፡ በህየ ፡ ወይንበሩ ፡ እስከ ፡ ለዓለም ፤
sentences.l: And-then they-prepared that they-make for-them what-is by-law, and-they-send-them to land-of Ethiopia and-they-reign there and-dwell for-ever;
sentences.i: Then they made ready to do for them what was lawful, and to send them to the land of Ethiopia, to reign there and to dwell there forever,
sentences.n: ወእምዝ አስተዳለዉ 'and then they prepared' (አስተዳለወ 'make ready', perfect 3rd plural). ከመ ይግበሩ ሎሙ ዘበሕግ 'that they do for them that which (is) by law' (ዘ- 'that which'; በሕግ 'by law'). ወይፈንውዎሙ 'and send them'. ብሔረ ኢትዮጵያ 'the land of Ethiopia' (ብሔረ construct). እስከ ለዓለም 'until forever' (ለዓለም 'for ever' is common in Geʿez).

sentences.t: እሙንቱ ፡ ወዘርኦሙ ፡ ለትውልደ ፡ ትውልድ ፨ ፨ ፨
sentences.l: they and-their-seed for-generation-of generation.
sentences.i: they and their descendants, from generation to generation.
sentences.n: ትውልደ ትውልድ 'generation of generation', the usual way of saying 'all generations'; ለ- 'for'. The three ፨ ፨ ፨ close the chapter and stay with its last unit.

sentences.t: ፴፱ ፡ ኀበ ፡ አንገሥዎ ፡ ለወልደ ፡ ሰሎሞን ።
sentences.l: 39. Where they-made-king-him, the-son-of Solomon.
sentences.i: Chapter 39: How they enthroned the son of Solomon.
sentences.n: Chapter heading. ኀበ 'where' (loosely 'how') as in ch. 37-38. አንገሥዎ 'they made him king' (አንገሠ + -ኦ); ለወልደ ሰሎሞን 'the son of Solomon': ለ- marks the object, and ወልደ is the construct 'son-of'. ፴፱ is the numeral 39 (30 + 9).

sentences.t: ወአስተዳለዉ ፡ ዕፍረተ ፡ ቅብአ ፡ መንግሥት ፡ ወተነፍኀ ፡ ቃለ ፡ ቀርን ፡ ወብዕዛ ፡ ወዕንዚራ ፡ ወመሰንቆ ፡ ወከበሮ ፡ ወጸርኀት ፡ ሀገር ፡ በውውዓ ፡ በትፍሥሕት ፡ ወበይባቤ ፤
sentences.l: And-they-prepared ointment-of anointing-of kingdom, and-was-blown the-sound-of horn and-bʿəza and-ʿənzira and-lyre and-drum, and-cried the-city in ዉዉዓ (?), in joy and in jubilation;
sentences.i: They prepared the perfumed oil for the anointing of kingship, and the sound was blown of horn, ብዕዛ and ዕንዚራ, lyre and drum, and the city cried out in ውውዓ (?), in gladness and in rejoicing;
sentences.n: ወአስተዳለዉ 'and they prepared'. ዕፍረተ ቅብአ መንግሥት 'perfume (of) anointing (of) kingship': ዕፍረት 'incense, perfumed ointment' in the construct before ቅብአ 'anointing', which stands before መንግሥት. ተነፍኀ 'was blown' (passive, ተነፍኀ). ቃለ ቀርን 'voice (sound) of horn'. The instrument names are uncertain (?): ቀርን 'horn'; ብዕዛ and ዕንዚራ I do not know securely, probably a pipe or horn and a harp (?); መሰንቆ is a stringed instrument (lyre, fiddle); ከበሮ is a drum. ወጸርኀት ሀገር 'and the city cried out' (ጸርኀ, 3rd fem. because ሀገር is feminine). በውውዓ is not known to me (?), perhaps a cry or shout. በትፍሥሕት 'in gladness', ወበይባቤ 'and in jubilation' (?).

sentences.t: ወአብእዎ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ቅድስተ ፡ ቅዱሳን ፡ ወተእኅዘ ፡ በአቅርንተ ፡ ምሥዋዕ ፡ ወተውህቦ ፡ መንግሥት ፡ በአፈ ፡ ሳዶቅ ፡ ካህን ፡ ወበአፈ ፡ ኢዮአስ ፡ ካህን ፡ መልአከ ፡ ኀይሉ ፡ ለንጉሥ ፡ ሰሎሞን ፡ ወቀብኦ ፡ እምነ ፡ ቅዱስ ፡ ቅብአ ፡ ዕፍረት ፡ ለመንግሥት ፤
sentences.l: And-they-brought-him into holy-of holies, and-he-took-hold at the-horns-of altar, and-was-given kingdom by mouth-of Zadok priest and by mouth-of Joas priest, angel-of his-might (?), of king Solomon (?), and-he-anointed-him with holy ointment-of perfume for kingdom;
sentences.i: They brought him into the Holy of Holies. He took hold of the horns of the altar, and the kingdom was given him by the mouth of Zadok the priest and by the mouth of Joas the priest, the messenger of his strength (?), on behalf of King Solomon (?), and anointed him with the holy perfumed oil for kingship;
sentences.n: ወአብእዎ 'and they brought him in' (አብአ, causative of ባአ 'enter'). ቅድስተ ቅዱሳን 'Holy of Holies' (ቅድስት 'holy place' in the construct before ቅዱሳን 'holy ones'): the royal consecration is set in the Temple's inner shrine. ተእኅዘ 'he was seized, held' or 'took hold'; በአቅርንተ ምሥዋዕ 'by the horns of the altar' (ቀርን, plural አቅርንት). The 'horns of the altar' are those of Exodus 27:2 and 1 Kings 1:50, where Adonijah seizes them; here it is a sacred place of ritual (?). ወተውህቦ መንግሥት 'and was given him kingdom' (ተውህበ passive of ሀበ + -ኦ). በአፈ 'by the mouth of' (አፍ 'mouth' construct, አፈ). ሳዶቅ ካህን is Zadok the priest, as in 1 Kings 1:39. ኢዮአስ ካህን 'Joas the priest' is not identified to me (?). መልአከ ኀይሉ 'angel (messenger) of his might' is obscure (?): I take it as a title of Joas ('the messenger of his strength'); ለንጉሥ ሰሎሞን 'of/for King Solomon' is ambiguous (?). ወቀብኦ 'and he anointed him' (ቀብአ). The subject is the priests. ቅብአ ዕፍረት 'oil of perfume' (ቅብእ 'oil, ointment').

sentences.t: ወወፅአ ፡ እምነ ፡ ቤተ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወሰመይዎ ፡ ስሞ ፡ ዳዊት ፡ እስመ ፡ በሕግ ፡ ረከቦ ፡ ስመ ፡ ንጉሥ ፤
sentences.l: And-went-out from house-of God, and-they-named-him his-name David, for by-law he-obtained the-name-of king;
sentences.i: He went out from the house of God, and they gave him the name David, because by law he had obtained the name of king;
sentences.n: ወወፅአ 'and he went out' (ወፅአ). እምነ ቤተ እግዚኣብሔር 'from the house of God': እምነ is a variant of እም- 'from' with the added -ነ. ወሰመይዎ ስሞ ዳዊት 'and they named him, his name (being) David': ሰመየ + -ኦ 'named him', with the name as a second object, ስሞ 'his name'. This means the son takes the regnal name David, in the line of the royal ancestor of Psalms. In Ethiopian tradition Menelik is crowned as David II. እስመ በሕግ ረከቦ ስመ ንጉሥ 'because by law he found (obtained) the name of king' (ረከበ 'find, receive'). The subject of ረከቦ could also be 'it', so 'because the name of king had come on him by law' (?).

sentences.t: ወአጽዐንዎ ፡ ዲበ ፡ በቅለ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ሰሎሞን ፡ ወአዖድዎ ፡ ሀገረ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ይብሉ ፡ ሤምናከ ፡ እምዝየ ፤
sentences.l: And-they-mounted-him upon mule-of king Solomon, and-they-paraded-him (round) the-city saying: We-have-appointed-you from-here (?);
sentences.i: They mounted him on King Solomon's mule and led him around the city, saying: 'We have appointed you from here on (?).'
sentences.n: ወአጽዐንዎ 'and they mounted him' (አጽዐነ, causative of ጸዐነ 'carry', so 'made him ride'). ዲበ 'upon'. በቅል 'mule' (?), the animal of kings in 1 Kings 1:33 (Solomon's own mule, in David's time). Here too the mule is the king's and the procession echoes Solomon's own. ወአዖድዎ ሀገረ 'and they led him around the city' (አዖደ, causative of ዐወደ 'go around'; ሀገረ accusative). እንዘ ይብሉ 'saying'. ሤምናከ 'we appointed you' (ሠየመ 'appoint', 1st plural perfect + -ከ 'you'). እምዝየ 'from here' (?), perhaps 'from now'.

sentences.t: ወእምዝ ፡ ይቤልዎ ፡ ባሕ ፡ ሕየው ፡ አበ ፡ ነጋሢ ፤
sentences.l: And-then said-to-him: ባሕ (?) 'live'(?), father of-king (?);
sentences.i: And then they said to him: 'ባሕ (?), live (?), father of a king (?).'
sentences.n: This line is very uncertain (?). ወእምዝ ይቤልዎ 'and then they said to him' (ይቤሉ + -ኦ). ባሕ is unknown to me (?), perhaps a word of acclamation. ሕየው I take as an imperative or jussive 'live!' (ሐይወ 'live') (?). አበ ነጋሢ 'father of a king' (አብ 'father' in the construct, ነጋሢ is a form meaning 'king, ruler' (?)); the phrase would honour the new king as father of kings. I give the sense as a hedge, not a firm reading.

sentences.t: ወቦ ፡ እለ ፡ ይብሉ ፡ ርቱዕ ፡ ይደልዎ ፡ እምፈለገ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ እስከ ፡ ምዕራበ ፡ ፀሐይ ፡ ይኩን ፡ ሢመትከ ፡ ኢትዮጵያ ፡ ቡሩክ ፡ ዘርእከ ፡ በዲበ ፡ ምድር ፡ ወእምሴዋ ፡ ደቡባዊ ፡ እስከ ፡ ሠረቀ ፡ ህንድ ፡ ዘታሠምሮን ፤
sentences.l: And-there-are those-who say: right (it is), it-befits-him: from river-of Egypt until west-of sun be your-office Ethiopia; blessed (be) your-seed upon earth, and from ሴዋ (?) southern until rising-of India, what you-make-pleasing for-them (?);
sentences.i: And there are some who say: 'It is right and fitting for him: from the river of Egypt to the west of the sun, let Ethiopia be your dominion; blessed be your descendants upon the earth, and from ሴዋ (?) in the south to the rising of the sun in India, whatever pleases them (?);
sentences.n: ወቦ እለ ይብሉ 'and there are those who say' (ቦ 'there is'). ርቱዕ 'right', ይደልዎ 'it befits him' (ደለወ 'be fitting' + -ኦ). እምፈለገ ግብጽ 'from the river of Egypt' (እም- + ፈለገ construct, 'river-of'); compare Genesis 15:18, 'from the river of Egypt', as the edge of the promised land. እስከ ምዕራበ ፀሐይ 'to the west of the sun', sunset. ሢመትከ 'your office, rule', with ኢትዮጵያ 'Ethiopia'. ቡሩክ ዘርእከ 'blessed (be) your seed' (ቡሩክ 'blessed'). ወእምሴዋ is uncertain (?): perhaps a place-name ሴዋ; ደቡባዊ 'southern'. ሠረቀ ህንድ 'the rising of India' (ሠረቀ 'rising' as a noun, of the sun); India stands at the east edge of the stretch. ዘታሠምሮን is hard (?): 'what you please them with' or 'what pleases them'; ታሠምሮን could be 2nd masc. or 3rd fem. with -ሆን 'them (fem.)'. The long boundaries claim Africa's whole breadth for the new king.

sentences.t: ወእግዚኣብሔር ፡ አምላከ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ይኩንከ ፡ መርሐ ፡ ወታቦተ ፡ ሕጉ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፡ ኀበ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ዘአንጸርከ ፤
sentences.l: And-God, God-of Israel, may-he-be-to-you guide, and the-Ark of-his law of-God (be) toward all that you-look-to (?);
sentences.i: May God, the God of Israel, be your guide, and the Ark of his law be with you toward whatever you set your face to (?);
sentences.n: ወእግዚኣብሔር አምላከ እስራኤል 'and the Lord, God of Israel' (አምላከ construct). ይኩንከ መርሐ 'may he be to you a guide' (ይኩን + -ከ; መርሕ 'guide', accusative). ወታቦተ ሕጉ ለእግዚኣብሔር 'and the Ark of his law (that of the Lord)': ታቦት, the Ark of the Covenant, the centre of the Kebra Nagast; the wish that the Ark be with the new king prepares the theft of the Ark (cf. the later chapters). ኀበ ኵሉ ዘአንጸርከ 'to all that you look toward' (አንጸረ 'look, face'; the sense 'wherever you turn' is a guess, ?).

sentences.t: ወይኩኑከ ፡ ግሩራነ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ ፀርከ ፡ ወጸላእትከ ፡ በቅድሜከ ፡ ወይኩንከ ፡ ፍጽመ ፡ ወኳላ ፡ ለከ ፡ ወለዘርእከ ፡ እምድኅሬከ ፡ ወትኴንን ፡ ብዙኃነ ፡ አሕዛበ ፡ ወለከሰ ፡ አልቦ ፡ ዘይኴንነከ ።
sentences.l: And-may-they-be-to-you subdued (?), all your-enemy and-haters before-you, and-may-be-to-you perfection and ኳላ (?) to-you and to-your-seed after-you, and-you-shall-rule many peoples; and-as-for-you, none shall-rule you.
sentences.i: May all your enemies and haters be cowed (?) before you, and may there be wholeness and support (?) for you and your descendants after you; you will rule many peoples, but no one will rule you.
sentences.n: ይኩኑከ 'may they be to you'. ግሩራነ is uncertain (?): I read 'cowed, subdued' by guess; ኵሎሙ ፀርከ ወጸላእትከ 'all your enemies and your haters' (ፀር, ጸላኢ, plural ጸላእት). በቅድሜከ 'before you'. ፍጽመ 'perfection, completeness'; ኳላ I do not know (?), perhaps 'support' or 'measure'. እምድኅሬከ 'after you'. ወትኴንን 'and you will rule' (ኰነነ 'judge, rule'); ብዙኃነ አሕዛበ 'many peoples'. ወለከሰ 'but as for you' (ለከ + -ሰ); ዘይኴንነከ 'who would rule you'. The wish for the king to rule nations and none to rule him resembles Genesis 27:29, Isaac's blessing (?).

sentences.t: ወካዕበ ፡ ባረኮ ፡ አቡሁ ፡ ወይቤሎ ፡ በረከተ ፡ ሰማይ ፡ ወምድር ፡ ይኩን ፡ በረከትከ ፤
sentences.l: And-again blessed-him his-father and-said-to-him: blessing of-heaven and-earth be your-blessing;
sentences.i: And again his father blessed him and said to him: 'May your blessing be the blessing of heaven and earth.'
sentences.n: ወካዕበ ባረኮ አቡሁ 'and again his father blessed him' (ባረከ + -ኦ); the father is Solomon. ወይቤሎ 'and said to him'. በረከተ ሰማይ ወምድር 'blessing of heaven and earth' (በረከተ construct). ይኩን በረከትከ 'let your blessing be'. Compare Genesis 49:25, 'blessings of heaven above and of the earth beneath' (?).

sentences.t: ወይቤሉ ፡ ማኅበረ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ አሜን ፨
sentences.l: And-said assembly-of Israel: Amen.
sentences.i: And the assembly of Israel said: 'Amen.'
sentences.n: ወይቤሉ 'and they said'. ማኅበረ እስራኤል 'the assembly of Israel' (ማኅበረ construct). አሜን 'Amen' is the usual response after a blessing, as in Psalm 106:48 and Deuteronomy 27:15-26. The ፨ marks a strong stop.

sentences.t: ወካዕበ ፡ አቡሁኒ ፡ ይቤሎ ፡ ለሰዶቅ ፡ ካህን ፡ አይድኦኬ ፡ ወንግሮ ፡ ፍትሖ ፡ ወኵነኔሁ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፡ ከመ ፡ ይዕቀብ ፡ በህየ ፨ ፨ ፨
sentences.l: And-again his-father also said to Zadok the-priest: make-known (to) him (?) and tell-him his-justice and judgment of-God, that he-keep (it) there.
sentences.i: And again his father said to Zadok the priest: 'Teach him, and tell him God's justice and judgment, that he may keep them there.'
sentences.n: ወካዕበ አቡሁኒ ይቤሎ 'and again his father also said to him'. ለሰዶቅ ካህን 'to Zadok the priest' (spelled ሰዶቅ here, ሳዶቅ earlier, both kept as printed). አይድኦኬ is not clear to me (?): perhaps አይድዕ 'make known' with -ኦ 'him', followed by an unclear -ኬ. ወንግሮ 'and tell him'. ፍትሖ 'his justice' (ፍትሕ 'justice, judgment'); ኵነኔሁ ለእግዚኣብሔር 'the judgment of God' (ኵነኔ 'judgment, rule'). ከመ ይዕቀብ 'that he keep, observe' (ዐቀበ). በህየ 'there'. The three ፨ ፨ ፨ close the chapter.
